summary: The gyomu-ai-compiler package is a specialized AI orchestration and compilation toolkit designed to automate documentation, docstring updates, package analysis, and document translation. It provides a modular pipeline architecture encompassing context modeling, prompt rendering, execution engines, and deterministic schema definitions for code intelligence operations.
responsibilities: Define data structures and schemas for deterministic docstring update plans, actions, and values.
Build LLM conversation messages from document context for various sections including architecture, design principles, editing rules, important constraints, and overview.
Model declaration contexts and file contexts for updating docstrings within the docstring update pipeline.
Execute document content translation with retry support and temporary state tracking.

capabilities.name: Docstring Management Schemas
capabilities.description: Defines structured schemas, replacement actions, and execution plans for deterministic AI-driven docstring generation and code updates.

capabilities.name: LLM Context Rendering
capabilities.description: Constructs conversation messages, prompts, and context structures for generating architectural overviews, constraints, and design sections.

capabilities.name: README Generation Pipelines
capabilities.description: Builds prompts, data structures, and message flows for creating comprehensive README documentation sections.

capabilities.name: Translation Execution Engine
capabilities.description: Executes document translation tasks incorporating retry mechanisms, temporary state tracking, and validation formatting.

capabilities.name: Code Declaration Contexts
capabilities.description: Models declaration contexts, file states, and retry options to support code analysis and docstring pipelines.

design_decisions: Organizes functionality into discrete pipeline modules that separate context modeling, prompt rendering, and execution logic.
Relies on structured schemas and action plans to make AI-driven code modifications deterministic and self-contained.
Incorporates robust execution controls such as retry limits and state tracking for AI content operations.
usage_guidance: Utilize the pipeline modules to orchestrate AI-driven generation tasks such as docstring updates, README creation, and content translation.
Leverage the schema definitions to ensure AI-driven modifications remain structured, deterministic, and self-contained.
Combine context modeling and rendering components to build custom prompt messages for specific document and architecture sections.
